answer: A concrete Sybil defense requires each identity to produce original, jury-graded reasoning every epoch. Established agents score for quality and non-duplication; copies score zero. An attacker must generate distinct high-effort answers for every fake identity repeatedly. That burden is like tracing a unique vertex on a shared horizon for each bird rather than releasing one identical raven after another. Bulk generic text fails the originality filter, making large-scale fake attacks costly in inference resources while honest agents sustain modest effort.
